hook.say: Rivers, lakes and one word you use without knowing it is Turkish geography. Five questions, go!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which two great rivers rise in Türkiye and flow on to Iraq?
questions.say: Which two great rivers rise in Turkey and flow on to Iraq?
questions.fact: They meet in Iraq and flow into the Persian Gulf.
questions.sayAnswer: The Euphrates and the Tigris! They meet in Iraq and flow into the Persian Gulf.

questions.q: Which giant salt lake lies in the heart of Central Anatolia?
questions.say: Which giant salt lake lies in the heart of Central Anatolia?
questions.fact: Tuz means salt. It is Türkiye's second-largest lake.
questions.sayAnswer: Lake Tooz! Tooz means salt, and it is Turkey's second-largest lake.

questions.q: Which is the longest river flowing entirely within Türkiye?
questions.say: Which is the longest river flowing entirely within Turkey?
questions.fact: Kızılırmak means Red River. It flows into the Black Sea.
questions.sayAnswer: The Kizil-irmak! Its name means Red River, and it flows into the Black Sea.

questions.q: Which Turkish river gave English the word "meander"?
questions.say: Which Turkish river gave English the word meander?
questions.fact: The ancient Greeks called this winding river the Maeander.
questions.sayAnswer: The Menderes! The ancient Greeks called this winding river the Meander.

questions.q: Which is Türkiye's largest freshwater lake?
questions.say: Which is Turkey's largest freshwater lake?
questions.fact: Lake Beyşehir covers about 650 km² in Konya and Isparta provinces.
questions.sayAnswer: Lake Bay-sheh-heer! It covers about 650 square kilometres in Konya and Isparta provinces.
